body:
Implement Wave 2 T-P17 from .adlc/specs/enhancement-resolution-plan.md:

1. Fix scopesOverlap in packages/core/lib/tickets.mjs to:
   - Handle leading **/ and * globs (e.g. **/*.mjs vs packages/core/** or concrete paths).
   - Enforce / segment boundaries on prefixes (e.g. packages/cli vs packages/cli-utils must not overlap; literal paths only overlap a glob if globMatch(glob, literal) is true).
   - Check direct globMatch both ways and suffix compatibility for wildcard-to-wildcard pairs.
   - Rebuild Cursor bundles via npm run build:cursor-mcp.

2. Fix and optimize packages/merge-forecast/lib/signals.mjs:
   - Add .worktrees and .claude to skipDirs in walkTree.
   - Pre-index file imports per (scopeIndex, root) in O(|F|) so importRadiusIntersects reads each repo file at most once across all O(T^2) ticket pairs.
   - Pre-index CodeGraph edges once in O(|E|) so signalGraphCoupling evaluates pairs without O(T^2 * |E| * |F|) scans.
   - Treat any non-empty index.files(a.scope) intersect index.files(b.scope) concrete-file intersection as hardVeto (score 1.0, signal 'scope-overlap', never PARALLEL).

3. Add unit/perf tests in packages/core/test/scopes-overlap.test.mjs and packages/merge-forecast/test/scope-index-perf.test.mjs, and update packages/merge-forecast/test/scope-index-wiring.test.mjs for the concrete-overlap lookup through scopeIndex.

Verification:
npm run build:cursor-mcp && node --test packages/core/test/scopes-overlap.test.mjs packages/core/test/core.test.mjs packages/merge-forecast/test scripts/test/ticket-store-boundary.test.mjs
title: Wave 2 T-P17 (R3 + P2): Accurate scopesOverlap leading-wildcard/boundary matching & O(|F|+|E|) pre-indexed merge-forecast
